snippet.title: Two Point Hospital: Full Health Collection | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Behold the Full Health Collection, bringing you Two Point Hospital and ALL the DLC in one easy to swallow bundle! This complete collection of DLCs offers you a wealth of locations, hospitals, items, gameplay and more! 
 
Available now on XBOX Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch 2. 
 
For the first time ever on consoles, cure a creative crisis in Culture Shock, aid anachronistic ailments in A Stitch in Time, and manage unorthodox ambulances in Speedy Recovery, these DLCs are bringing with them 9 hospitals to manage, gameplay mechanics, and over 80 illnesses to cure! The Full Health Collection also includes Bigfoot, Pebberley Island, Close Encounters & Off the Grid expansions PLUS a booster of free items, including the Retro Items Pack, Fancy Dress Pack, and more! 
 
The Full Health Collection is available physically on PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch 2: https://www.twopointstudios.com/en/two-point-county/two-point-hospital/two-point-hospital-full-health-collection-physical
